title: The brave fight is inward
summary: True courage subdues the vicious ego within, not another person. Win the inward war by praising Naam.
takeaway: Win the inward war by praising Naam.
lifeApplication: When you want to defeat someone, turn first toward the vicious ego within and answer it with praise.

source.shortMeaning: True courage subdues the vicious ego within, not another person.
source.lifeApplication: When conflict sharpens, fight the ego within before you fight anyone else.
